title: Consistency of augmentation graph and network approximability in contrastive learning
abstract: arXiv:2502.04312v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Contrastive learning leverages data augmentation to develop feature representation without relying on large labeled datasets. However, despite its empirical success, the theoretical foundations of contrastive learning remain incomplete, with many essential guarantees left unaddressed, particularly the realizability assumption concerning neural approximability of an optimal spectral contrastive loss solution. In this work, we overcome these limitations by analyzing pointwise and spectral consistency of the augmentation graph Laplacian. We establish that, under specific conditions for data generation and graph connectivity, as the augmented dataset size increases, the augmentation graph Laplacian converges to a weighted Laplace-Beltrami operator on the natural data manifold. translated_title: 对比学习中增广图的一致性与网络可逼近性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2502.04312v3 公告类型：替换。摘要：对比学习利用数据增强技术，在不依赖大规模标注数据集的情况下学习特征表示。然而，尽管对比学习在经验上取得了成功，其理论基础仍不完善，许多关键的理论保证尚未得到解决，尤其是关于最优谱对比损失解的神经网络可逼近性这一可实现性假设。在本工作中，我们通过分析增广图拉普拉斯算子的逐点一致性与谱一致性来克服这些局限。我们证明，在数据生成和图连通性的特定条件下，随着增强数据集规模的增大，增广图拉普拉斯算子收敛于自然数据流形上的加权拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子。这些一致性结果确保了图拉普拉斯谱能够有效捕捉流形的几何结构。因此，它们为构建一个稳健的框架奠定了基础（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文证明了在特定数据生成与图连通性条件下，增广图拉普拉斯算子随增强数据集规模增大而收敛于数据流形上的加权拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子，从而为谱对比损失最优解的神经网络可逼近性假设提供了严格的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that under specific data generation and graph connectivity conditions, the augmentation graph Laplacian converges to a weighted Laplace-Beltrami operator on the data manifold as the augmented dataset grows, thereby providing rigorous theoretical guarantees for the realizability assumption on neural network approximability of the optimal spectral contrastive loss solution.
